questions.question: List all the factors of 48 in pairs.
questions.expected_answer: 1 and 48, 2 and 24, 3 and 16, 4 and 12, 6 and 8. The factors are 1, 2, 3, 4, 6, 8, 12, 16, 24 and 48.

questions.question: Explain the difference between a multiple and a factor using 12 and 48.
questions.expected_answer: 48 is a multiple of 12, because 12 times 4 is 48, so 48 is in the 12 times table. 12 is a factor of 48, because 12 divides into 48 exactly with nothing left over.

questions.question: Juice comes in packs of 12 and muffins in packs of 18. What is the smallest number of each you can buy to have the same number of juices and muffins?
questions.expected_answer: The multiples of 12 are 12, 24, 36, 48 and the multiples of 18 are 18, 36, 54. The first common multiple is 36, so buy 3 packs of juice and 2 packs of muffins to have 36 of each.
